notes: REVIEWER-VERIFIED EXACT-SKU DOCUMENT, read directly by an independent reviewer transport. States: Stella McCartney Kids, designer code TU0A28Z0699 226VI, Giglio code 401012, composition 100% Polyurethane, and four product gallery links.

skuInBody is asserted because the reviewer read the article in the DOCUMENT BODY. It is not inferred from the article appearing in the URL path, which is a distinction the pipeline now records separately.
THE FOUR GALLERY URLS ARE EXACT OBSERVED LINK TARGETS from that document. They were neither constructed nor guessed, and no template was extrapolated from them.

TIER IS TRUSTED_RETAILER, NOT OFFICIAL. Giglio is a retailer we are permitted to fetch from; being on the allow-list never made it a manufacturer. Media from here must never be presented as brand-official.

ALIAS 401012.003 IS COLOUR-SCOPED. Giglio asset paths carry its own product code rather than the designer code, so the alias is what lets the identity gate recognise the retailer's own images. Bare 401012 is deliberately NOT used: the .003 suffix is the colour variant and dropping it would loosen variant matching.
COMPOSITION 100% Polyurethane is publishable from this exact-SKU document. DIMENSIONS ARE NOT: no exact-product document read so far states them.
CORROBORATING MODEL EVIDENCE ONLY. Measured page_has_sku False, so this page does not name the article and may not carry dimensions or any other specification into publication on its own.

PASS 12 — REVIEWER-VERIFIED GALLERY INGEST. The four img.giglio.com URLs are exact observed link targets from the reviewer-read product document, handed to the pipeline as media candidates. Reviewer verification is NOT byte validation: each URL still goes through host check, fetch, MIME, dimensions, non-product guards, identity, hash, dedupe, perceptual uniqueness, variant confidence and backdrop detection.

TIER: TRUSTED_RETAILER. The authority fix means Giglio is no longer misread as OFFICIAL merely for being on the allow-list, so the official routes stay applicable and are not suppressed by retailer media.
Product is a bag: ONE SIZE is the whole availability truth, verified against the live engine. No sold-out variants, and no retailer stock state imported.
CHILD-SERIES SUPPRESSION APPLIES — internal only, never in public name, copy, category, tags or alt text, and no opposite adult/unisex claim either.
